claim.claim-text: tracking (202) RFID tags (106) affixed to luggage items (108) within an aircraft cabin (104) to monitor distribution and/or movement of the luggage items within the aircraft cabin; and collecting (210) RFID data from tracking the RFID tags for a plurality of flights; and optimizing boarding (212) and/or deboarding process(es) based on the RFID data.
2. The method as recited in claim 1, wherein tracking RFID tags includes detecting (204) the RFID tags using a plurality of RFID readers (102) located in overhead bins (112) of the aircraft cabin.
3. The method as recited in claim 1 or 2, further comprising, informing (206) a user of where overhead bin space is available to receive luggage items within the aircraft cabin.
4. The method as recited in claim 1, 2 or 3, further comprising informing (208) a user how to redistribute the luggage items to improve aircraft weight distribution.
